note: Ironclad Hearthguard (unit identity, Ironclad): vindicator, biped, broad and short; a riveted box helm with cheek plates and an ember crest over a copper beard braided to the belt, layered slab pauldrons, a breastplate over a soot-iron scale coat, a chequy team tabard, a brass-buckled belt, knee cops and sabatons; the shield on the left arm. Tier I only in the first pass. No back flag.
